recommendation_summary: Rejects spreadsheet red formatting and reminders as the safeguard because they are advisory and race-prone. Recommends now a single system of record for reservations (item_id, start/end dates) with one save path. That path checks for overlap and inserts or rejects inside a single transaction, and returns an error to the second simultaneous submitter. The spreadsheet may stay this week only as a view or input form that submits to the validator, never saving directly. There are no extra features. The reply omits all four required record labels.
note: The recommendation meets LARGER (atomic transactional check, second concurrent submitter rejected), but none of the four required labeled record lines appear, so every record predicate fails.
